value_types.age: {lower?, upper?, unit, reference, at, source_text}; bound required; lower <= upper; exact when equal
value_types.stage: {label, source_declared, rule_id?, rule_version?}; derived stage requires rule and known species
value_types.clock: {reference, first_sample?, origin_seconds?, rate_hz?, timestamps_reference?}; per-stream native time
value_types.calibration: {source_unit, physical_unit, scale, offset, mapping}; physical = stored * scale + offset
value_types.coordinates: {values, unit, frame, provenance}; values must reference stable electrode IDs

definition.zh-CN: 去标识的来源对象ID；不能跨数据集仅凭同名合并。
definition.en: De-identified source subject ID; matching names across datasets do not establish identity.

definition.zh-CN: 保留来源物种文本；有依据时映射学名及分类标识，不默认人类。
definition.en: Preserve source species text; map a scientific name and taxonomy ID only with evidence, never assume human.

definition.zh-CN: 数值或区间、单位、年龄起点及所属时间；不把实验开始年龄当本次记录精确年龄。
definition.en: Value or interval, unit, reference event and time context; age at experiment start is not exact age at this session.

definition.zh-CN: 来源声明或按明确物种规则派生；保留规则版本，不反推实际年龄。
definition.en: Source-declared or derived under an explicit species-specific rule; retain rule version, do not infer numeric age.

definition.zh-CN: 保留来源定义与原值；不能把未提供解释成某一种性别。
definition.en: Retain the source definition and value; missing does not identify a sex.

definition.zh-CN: 动物品系、基因型分别记录；未知不自动填野生型。
definition.en: Record animal strain and genotype separately; unknown must not become wild type.

definition.zh-CN: 可有多个有来源的背景；健康对照须有声明，药物处理不自动成为疾病。
definition.en: Multiple sourced backgrounds are allowed; healthy control requires evidence, treatment is not automatically disease.

definition.zh-CN: 本次原始或派生记录的稳定ID，区别于受试对象ID。
definition.en: Stable ID for this source or derived recording, distinct from subject ID.

definition.zh-CN: 主文件、配套成员、格式、校验算法和值；格式不证明模态。
definition.en: Main file, companions, format, digest algorithm and value; format does not establish modality.

definition.zh-CN: continuous_voltage、epoched_voltage、sorted_units、derived_feature或unknown；可描述不代表可执行。
definition.en: continuous_voltage, epoched_voltage, sorted_units, derived_feature or unknown; representability is not execution support.

definition.zh-CN: scalp、cortical_surface、depth、other或unknown；允许同文件多组。
definition.en: scalp, cortical_surface, depth, other or unknown; one file may contain multiple groups.

definition.zh-CN: 每流稳定ID、源对象路径及通道映射；多流不默认拼接。
definition.en: Stable stream IDs, source object paths and channel maps; do not concatenate by default.

definition.zh-CN: 原生采样率，Hz；保留头声明和时钟估计的差异，不取均值掩盖冲突。
definition.en: Native rate in Hz; preserve disagreement between header and timestamps, do not average it away.

definition.zh-CN: 每流实际样本数，不由四舍五入后的时长反算。
definition.en: Actual samples per stream, not inferred from rounded duration.

definition.zh-CN: 记录存储时长与实验声明时长分开，单位s；不把填充当真实实验时间。
definition.en: Store file and declared experimental duration separately in seconds; padding is not observed experimental time.

definition.zh-CN: 源首样本、时间原点、时间戳或采样率及其参照；非零起点保留。
definition.en: Source first sample, time origin, timestamps or rate and reference; retain nonzero origins.

definition.zh-CN: continuous、epoched、discontinuous或unknown，以及已知连续段/缺口。
definition.en: continuous, epoched, discontinuous or unknown, with known segments and gaps.

definition.zh-CN: 所选流、源通道及样本半开区间；范围改变应生成新计划。
definition.en: Selected stream, source channels and half-open sample interval; changed selection requires a new plan.

definition.zh-CN: 稳定ID、源索引、源名称、声明类型、确认角色；重名不合并，数字同步道不作神经电压。
definition.en: Stable ID, source index/name, declared type and confirmed role; duplicate names stay distinct and digital sync is not neural voltage.

definition.zh-CN: 源单位、转换系数和偏置、物理单位、依据及可信状态；未知单位禁用绝对幅度判据。
definition.en: Source unit, scale/offset, physical unit, evidence and confidence; unknown units disable absolute-amplitude criteria.

definition.zh-CN: 采集参考、当前参考及可比通道组分别保存；ECG/EOG辅助道不等于参考电极。
definition.en: Separate acquisition reference, current reference and comparable groups; ECG/EOG auxiliary channels are not reference electrodes.

definition.zh-CN: 接触点ID、通道到电极的映射、正负极关系；接触点数量不等于通道数量。
definition.en: Contact IDs, channel-to-contact mapping and positive/negative contacts; contact count is not channel count.

definition.zh-CN: 坐标值、单位、坐标系及实测/模板来源必须一起记录；未知时禁用依赖位置的操作。
definition.en: Coordinate values, units, frame and measured/template provenance are inseparable; missing positions disable spatial operations.

definition.zh-CN: 厂商、型号、采集技术及证据；Neuropixels是技术/设备，不是物种或文件格式。
definition.en: Manufacturer, model, technology and evidence; Neuropixels is a technology/device, not a species or format.

definition.zh-CN: probe、shank、site、网格或电极杆关系及来源；不能仅凭名字建立邻接。
definition.en: Sourced probe, shank, site, grid or shaft relations; names alone do not establish adjacency.

definition.zh-CN: 硬件/采集软件的滤波及参数；未知与明确未滤波不同。
definition.en: Hardware/acquisition software filters and parameters; unknown is distinct from explicitly unfiltered.

definition.zh-CN: 明确声明的50/60Hz等供电频率；信号谱峰与供电声明分别保存。
definition.en: Declared mains frequency such as 50/60 Hz; distinguish a measured spectral peak from a supply declaration.

definition.zh-CN: 任务ID、名称和来源；同一session多任务应有时段。
definition.en: Task ID, name and source; multiple tasks in one session need intervals.

definition.zh-CN: 清醒、睡眠、麻醉等按带时钟的时段记录；整个session的粗声明也应注明覆盖。
definition.en: Record wake, sleep and anesthesia with clocked intervals; coarse session declarations also state coverage.

definition.zh-CN: 原始标签、时间/样本、持续时间、时钟及映射；点事件不虚构持续时间。
definition.en: Source label, time/sample, duration, clock and mapping; point events do not acquire invented duration.

definition.zh-CN: 区分未提取、已查未发现、部分提取及已提取的范围；不以空列表证明无事件。
definition.en: Distinguish not extracted, checked absent, partially extracted and extracted scope; an empty list alone does not prove absence.

definition.zh-CN: 来源是否处理、父记录和关系；不知道处理史不等于原始。
definition.en: Processing status, parent recording and relationship; unknown history does not establish raw data.

definition.zh-CN: 滤波、重参考、重采样、插值、ICA/ASR等顺序、参数、范围及软件版本。
definition.en: Ordered filtering, re-referencing, resampling, interpolation, ICA/ASR with parameters, scope and software versions.

definition.zh-CN: 来源URL/DOI、固定版本、许可与冲突；原始声明和平台判断分开。
definition.en: Source URL/DOI, fixed version, license and conflicts; separate source declarations from platform decisions.

definition.zh-CN: 字段字典版本、描述版本及父版本；旧任务冻结原描述，不回填新结论。
definition.en: Dictionary version, descriptor revision and parent; historical jobs retain their original description.
